snippet.title: Monster Truck Rally (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - INTV, Sept 1991 (Original Hardware)
snippet.description:
Monster Truck Rally was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in September 1991. All audio/visual elements copyright 1991, INTV. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/monster-truck-rally/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT MONSTER TRUCK RALLY (NES)

The object of the MONSTER TRUCK RALLY is to score as high as you can against up to three human or computer controlled opponents. Scores are determined by how quickly you navigate as well as other factors (sled pull distance, number of cars crushed). Or, rather than competing against others, just try to top your personal best lap times and scores.
